name: Collateral Substitution Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies if the collateral that is substituted was posted against the variation margin or the independent amount.

AVMG.name: Against Variation Margin
AVMG.definition: Specifies if the collateral that is substituted was posted against the variation margin.

ASIA.name: Against Segregated Independent Amount
ASIA.definition: Specifies if the collateral that is substituted was posted against the independent amount.
